thread:
alex: Heads-up — noticed a small spike in the pilot cohort canary. session-affinity + cross-region routing hitting cold KV prefixes. error rate ~1.8% and a few p99 outliers.
rachel: saw it on the console. host-local prefix miss rate is up. affinity keeps directing same users to hosts that haven't been primed.
kai: sticky routing causing hotspots. quick ideas: shorten lease TTL so affinity decays, or fallback to stateless LB earlier to spread heat.
alex: tradeoffs? consistency vs latency. shortening TTL might bounce users around and increase cross-variant prefix misses.
rachel: suggest a blended scoring signal for automated fallback: error rate, p99 delta vs baseline, host cache hit ratio, per-tenant error budget burn. sketch:
```
score = w1*err_rate + w2*max(0, (p99 - baseline_p99)/baseline_p99) + w3*(1-cache_hit)
if score > 0.7 for 30s across >50% hosts -> trigger fallback
```
weights tuned per traffic class.
kai: +1. add hysteresis and a grace window so short blips don't flip. also a "consistency penalty" when fallback implies switching model family — big penalty to prefer cache-preserving fallbacks first.
alex: enumerate fallback actions and order?
rachel: prioritized list: 1) return cached prefix + truncated continuation (fast, low-risk) 2) route to warm variant in-region (e.g., quantized variant) 3) cross-region warm fallback (higher latency) 4) degrade to canned structured response for non-critical routes. prefer (1) for multi-turn chat, (2) for transactional calls.
kai: implement fallback controller as pluggable policy DSL, not hard-coded. simple state machine: PROBE -> DECIDE -> ENFORCE -> AUDIT. probe collects signals, decide evaluates score, enforce flips routing or injects cached response, audit emits telemetry events.
deploy-bot: canary deploy 5876543210 started for pilot-cohort/pilot-42 :rocket:
ops-bot: alert: pilot-cohort error rate threshold crossed (1.5%) — page if sustained >5m.
alex: telemetry requirements: per-tenant & per-route cache hit rates, fallback invocations, decision scores, and winner/loser model ids. surface in Console + short alert runbook.
rachel: also need a low-latency warmup loop: when fallback triggers, spawn background prefill jobs that sample top-K prefixes and prime host KV.
kai: warmup shouldn't consume normal request quota. background prefetch must be rate-limited and low priority. avoid double-billing client tokens.
infra-team: can expose per-tenant cache metrics and add a warmup worker prototype.
alex: ops runbook snippet: - if automated fallback repeats, inspect host cache heatmap and TTLs - if fallback score oscillates, increase hysteresis and extend evaluation window - last resort: rollback canary or pin cohort to dedicated capacity.
rachel: action items: rachel -> prototype scoring + dashboard panel; kai -> policy DSL sketch & state machine prototype; infra-team -> expose metrics & warmup worker; alex -> one-pager runbook and SLA mapping.
alex: thanks all, sync tomorrow 10am to review prototypes. assigning owners in tracker. :thumbsup:
